name: Work and Residence Permit -- Paid Employment

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a labour contract with a single Aruban employer in a specified job title -- working for more than one employer under the same permit is not permitted.

Requires a positive labour market test statement from the DPL (Departamento di Labor / Department of Labor) before DIMAS will process the residence permit application; resident domestic staff are exempt.
Requires the employer's Chamber of Commerce (KVK) registration and confirmation of the applicant's social security (SVB) registration.

outcome.duration_length: tied to the labour contract; not specified in sources reviewed

sources.title: DIMAS, Government of Aruba -- Paid Employment: single-employer rule, DPL labour market testing process, required documentation list, DPL-then-DIMAS two-step process
Government of Aruba -- Work and Residence Permit: requirement for a positive DPL advice before a work permit is issued by DIMAS; tourists may not undertake paid employment through an Aruban employer

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Aruba's initial build. work_rights is 'restricted' (tied to the specific certified employer and job title, not portable to another employer without a fresh DPL clearance). No fee or standard permit-duration figures were found on the DIMAS or gobierno.aw pages reviewed -- flagged as a gap. leads_to_pr/pr_after_months (120 months) reflects the Indefinite Period Residence route's own stated threshold (see aw_indefinite_residence.json) -- a temporary Work and Residence Permit is the ordinary way a foreign national accumulates that 120-month clock, since no single temporary permit may exceed 3 years and must be renewed to reach it. Separately, a Work Permit holder becomes eligible to sponsor family after only 3 years of legal residence under the family reunification 'temporary residence permit holder' ground -- a materially faster and different benefit from indefinite residence itself; see aw_family_reunification.json.
